To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the short-term intermittency of PV output is a result of transient weather disturbances and that the geographical dispersion of the PV systems can help to reduce the impact of this intermittency.
the short-term variations in the generation output of PV systems can be modeled using Markov models.
the short-term variations in generation output of a geographically dispersed PV system can be reduced to the level of a power grid with the help of Monte Carlo simulations and a Markov model.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the impact of the short-term variations of the generation output of geographically dispersed solar PV systems.
the development of a methodology to evaluate the short-term variations of the PV system and to estimate the generation output of geographically distributed PV system.
how to integrate PV into the grid and how to manage the variability in the output.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the short-term variability in generation output of geographically dispersed photovoltaic systems could cope with the peak demand of a grid in one-minute time intervals.
the short-term variations in the generation output of geographically dispersed photovoltaic (pv) systems could be managed by a power grid.
the short-term variations of the generation output of geographically dispersed solar PV systems are not as large as previously thought.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
PV generation is a viable source for meeting short-term power demand in the near future.
the PV generation output can be predicted with a high degree of certainty in the near future.
the intermittency and uncertainty of PV systems can be mitigated by using a combination of multiple PV systems and storage systems.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a large PV generation system can be integrated into the grid in one-minute time intervals without any significant impact on the grid.
the short-term intermittency of the PV generation output should not be ignored in the design of a PV system.
the PV output in one minute intervals can be used as a proxy to the actual PV output in one-minute intervals.
